meta.name: webapp-testing
meta.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.

copy.tagline: 用 Playwright 测试本地 Web 应用的前端功能与 UI 行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化测试本地 Web 应用的前端功能与界面
copy.tagline_en: Test local web apps with Playwright for frontend functionality and UI behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate testing of local web apps' frontend and UI

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以编写并运行 Playwright 脚本，自动测试本地网页应用：打开页面、点击按钮、截图、查看控制台日志等。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 测试一个本地运行的网页应用（如前端项目），或需要验证页面功能、调试 UI 时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试本地运行的 React 应用，打开首页并截图。
say.note: Claude 会启动服务器、打开页面并截图保存。

say.text: 检查这个本地网页上所有按钮是否可点击。
say.note: Claude 会编写脚本遍历按钮并尝试点击。

say.text: 捕获这个本地应用的浏览器控制台日志。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本并返回日志内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write and run Playwright scripts to test local web apps: open pages, click buttons, take screenshots, and view console logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to test a locally running web application (e.g., a frontend project) or to verify page functionality or debug UI.

say_en.text: Test my locally running React app, open the homepage and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will start the server, open the page, and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Check if all buttons on this local page are clickable.
say_en.note: Claude will write a script to iterate and try clicking buttons.

say_en.text: Capture the browser console logs of this local app.
say_en.note: Claude will run the script and return the log content.
